description: Vendored Isoflow source for BK-Lite architecture diagrams. This directory is not an npm package: the name field is omitted so dependency scanners do not treat an unregistered package name as an installable dependency. Next imports this directory; main and types point at dist. Build dependencies live in the web package devDependencies. Source: x-isoflow-react-19@1.1.1 (gitHead 0dd5948c) with the 1.1.1-patch-6 behavior deltas.
